sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF is a 600 million parameter causal language model from the Qwen3 series, quantized in GGUF format by unsloth. The most important thing to understand before using this model: it seamlessly switches between thinking mode (for complex reasoning, math, and coding) and non-thinking mode (for fast, general dialogue) within a single model, controlled via the enable_thinking ...
